batting.dismissal: c Rashid Khan b MM Sharma

balls.text: slower short ball again, Cummins again doesn't time the pull shot well enough, and can only find square leg. They keep running off that last ball, and Samad ends up being run out
off cutter this time, short of a length, Samad waits but it barely even reaches him, so he can only manage to bunt it towards deep square leg
back of the hand slower ball, Cummins gets across and swipes it to deep midwicket to get Samad back on strike

Off cutter this time, dug in short, Washington connects nicely with the pull, but doesn't get enough power behind it and hits it straight to Rashid at deep midwicket. Samad is disappointed at being starved of the strike here.
back of the hand slower ball again, Shahbaz gets absolutely no timing on it, and ends up clonking it straight up in the air, Tewatia runs in from long-on to complete an easy catch
back of the hand slower ball, angling across Shahbaz as well, he plays an ugly hoick and gets nowhere near the ball

Pace on this time, fuller length, Shahbaz goes for the ramp and gets hit on the pad. Nalkande is the only one appealing, the umpire says no. Gill reviews, but it's clearly hit the inside edge first, so Shahbaz will stay.
sower short ball again, Shahbaz looks to help this with a pull over short fine leg, but only gloves it and it goes through to Saha on the bounce
Clean hit from Shahbaz! Nalkande was getting a bit too predictable, it was too short for the slower ball, Shahbaz waits on it and then mows it 85m towards the stands at cow corner
fuller this time, pace on, Samad digs this out towards midwicket, where Umesh gives it a good chase to keep it down to one

Umesh puts it down! Short ball with all the pace taken off again, Samad gets no timing on it as looked to pull it over the midwicket boundary, Umesh runs to his right and puts in the dive, but can't hold on

takes pace off, pitches on a good length well outside off stump, Samad walks across and looks to mow it across the line, but doesn't time it at all. Eventually, that helps him out as they run through for a couple of runs by the time deep midwicket came in to pick that one up
slower ball, short again, Samad pulls to deep midwicket
Clean as a whistle from Samad! Low full toss around middle stump again, Samad gets low and then gets the hands swinging through cleanly to get this over the long-on boundary
slower ball at 120ks, dug in really short, Shahbaz waits on it and pulls it away to deep square leg
goes for the yorker on middle stump, ends up as a low full toss, Samad chips this out to long-on
wide yorker, gets underneath Samad's bat as he looks to flay it through point
slower ball, on a length on middle stump, Shahbaz swats it away to deep midwicket
shot! Tossed up too full, Samad plants the front forward and hits through the line and past Rashid.
length ball on middle and leg, Shahbaz somehow gets glove on a sweep as it dribbles through to short fine
googly, pitches on middle and off, Samad flicks it uppishly towards long-on
length ball on middle and leg, swept away to deep backward square
Unfurls the reverse sweep about three weeks before Rashid released that ball. The bowler see it, completely slows it down, and beats the batter
filthy full toss to begin his final over, Shahbaz sweeps it fimrly, Nalkande does nicely to run quickly to his right, and making a diving stop
off cutter again, Shahbaz lines it up and looks to send it to next week over long-on. But he times it so badly that it barely crosses the 30-yard circle, as Mohit picks it up on the bounce
slower ball, dug in short, Samad pulls it on the bounce to deep midwicket
off cutter again, pitching on middle and off, Shahbaz pushes it towards extra cover and they set off for a quick run
off cutter, pitching on off stump, Shahbaz steers it to backward point and sets off for a run, but gets sent back by samad
length ball just outside off, driven to deep point
slower short ball, Samad lets it go, looks to the umpire for a wide, and gets the call in his favour
Slower ball, short as well, but doesn't rise at all, Shahbaz stays low and swats it deep backward square leg
How hard has he hit that? Length ball from Umesh, Samad charges at him and belts it straight back, flying through him before he could even get his hands up in a catching position
That's a glorious shot first up! Umesh digs this one in short, Samad helped that along with a nice, controlled pull shot. Finds the gap between backward square and fine leg too

Markram's timed that one too well, and that is his undoing! Length ball from Umesh, Markram plays the on-drive aerially, hits it too well, Rashid runs forward, slides and pouches it. The home fans are ecstatic!
bangs it in back of a length, Shahbaz looks to pull it but doesn't make the perfect connection with it. It still goes through to long-on for a single
length ball on off stump, dabbed straight to backward point
Pristine timing from Shahbaz! Poor ball from Umesh, too full and too wide, Shahbaz leans into it and drives it nicely past point and past the man in the deep as well

Tight run, but Markram's home. Shahbaz rocks back and cuts it straight to Nalkande at short third, his throw lacks power and is not right at the stumps either. That gives Markram enough time to make his ground before Saha whips the bails out
Shahbaz is completely at sea against the googly first up, it pitches on off stump and fizzes further away. Shahbaz looks to close the phase to work it towards the legside but is beaten

Massive moment in the game! Rashid bids goodbye to Klaasen. Flatter delivery, on a length and attacking the stumps, Klaasen looks to go back and mow it over midwicket, misses it and sees his stumps rearranged. Rashid has his hands aloft, Gill is ecstatic, and rightfully so.
slower this time, on a length on leg stump, Markram tucks it to deep midwicket
fired in back of a length on middle stump, Klaasen goes back and powers it all along the ground past Rashid, they only get a single though, as Miller does the fielding at long-on
flatter trajectory, but short and wide, Klaasen cuts it away powerfully in front of square
length ball pitching on middle and leg, turning back in, Klaasen flicks it to midwicket with the spin
flatter, short and wide, bunted straight to extra cover
This time, he perfects the slog sweep! It's a similar ball from Noor, Klaasen gets down on one knee and sends it a few rows back into the Motera stands
Klaasen is into his work now! Tossed up on a length on middle and leg, slog sweep had Omarzai at deep midwicket interested, but it flies just over his head
flatter this time, back of a length on leg stump and turning back in to deny Klaasen any room. He gets an inside edge on to his pad as he looked to whip it to midwicket
tossed up full on leg stump, it is a googly, Markram plays with the turn and drives it to long-off
digs this one in short, but takes all the pace off it, Markram waits on it and then swats it to deep midwicket
off cutter again, length ball attacking the stumps too, Markram drives aerially down the ground and they get a couple before Miller does the fielding at long-on
off cutter, back of a length on middle and leg, Klaasen tucks it to deep midwicket
slower ball out of the back of the hand. Klaasen flat bats it straight but Mohit stops it in his follow through
full toss on middle stump, Klaasen check drives down the ground to the bowler's right. Long-on moves to his left and does the fielding as they get two
length ball attacking the stumps, pace on, Markram elegantly punches to long-on
flatter this time, outside off, Markram's quickly on the backfoot to cut this to Shankar at deep point. Much more straightforward fielding effort for him this time.

That's more like it from Markram, it's a similar ball from Noor this time, but Markram moves to the legside and drives it over extra cover. Vijay Shankar covers good ground to his right from deep point to make the diving stop to keep it down to two
googly, tossed up, pitching on off stump and turning further away. An ugly hack from Markram as he gets beaten
length ball on off stump, Klaasen drives down the ground, a tad uppish, but safe enough as it beats Noor's dive to his left
poor ball, Klaasen's away with a boundary. Flatter ball, full and on the pads, an absolute freebie, Klaasen just uses the pace and glances it fine
short of a length, pitching on off and turning back in, Markram steers this behind square on the offside and runs through for a single

Soft dismissal. Slower ball, on a length on off stump, Abhishek is too early into an attempted off drive, so he can only slice that straight to Gill at extra cover. Completely lost his balance on that shot, the bottom hand came off the bat as well.
length ball on off stump, Markram commits to the forward punch and then drives languidly down the ground
slower ball dug in short, Abhishek waits on it and pulls it to deep square leg
takes pace off this time, back of a length as well, Markram pulls to deep midwicket
hits a length around off stump and angles it across the leftie, Abhishek moves across and then punches to mid-on
Goes pace on first up, full length on middle and leg, Markram whips it to mid-on
tossed up, length ball on middle and off stump, Abhishek gets down on one knee and sweeps it square into the gap between deep backward square leg and deep midwicket

Given out caught behind! Abhishek sends it upstairs straightaway. Short and just outside off, too close to cut even as Abhishek attempts that shot. Ultraedge shows no contact between bat and ball. Abhishek was very confident with that review.
flatter trajectory this time, pitches on a length on middle and leg, Abhishek goes back and pushes it back to the bowler
full ball just outside off, some flight this time, Abhishek doesn't connect well enough with the slog sweep, and hits it straight to midwicket
googly again, length ball, just doesn't arrive at Markram, he's too early into the shot and ends up bunting it to long-off off the bottom of the bat
googly again, full length on middle and leg, Markram gets forward and drives to extra cover
length ball, pitching just outside off stump, Abhishek flat bats it over extra cover, and they get back for a couple as Vijay Shankar runs across to keep the runs down to two
full ball on middle and leg, Markram comes forward and drives to long-on
length ball just outside off, Markram goes back and steers it to backward point
length ball on leg stump, Abhishek goes back and turns it square on the legside
shorter length this time, just wide of off stump, cut away to extra cover
googly, pitching on middle stump, Abhishek looks to clear the front leg and belt it over the covers, misses it
length ball, a touch too wide this time, Markram rocks back and cuts this behind square, past a diving short third The fielder from sweeper cover runs to his left and cuts it off
googly again, pitching on middle and leg, Markram pushes forward and defends it back to the bowler
Noor strikes gold for the Titans! It's the googly again, pitching just outside off stump, Head goes for the slog sweep but completely misses it, and the furniture is rattled.
length ball on off and middle, tucked away to deep midwicket!
Googly, which Abhishek doesn't read, gets an inside edge on a forward push and it jsut dribbles past the stumps
Bursts right through his fingers! This one's tossed up around off stump, Head belted it straight back to Noor's right, but he gets only fingertips on it, and it then goes through to long-off
short this time, angling into leg stump, Head rocks back and bunts it to long-on
short and wide from Rashid, Head cuts it straight to backward point
length ball on leg stump, played to deep midwicket off the backfoot
And again, Abhishek is the boss here! Rashid pulls the length back a touch and moves the line towards off as well, but Abhishek dances down and deposits it over the long-off boundary
Abhishek loves facing spin, and he shows Rashid exactly that first up! This one is a poor ball though, it's tossed up full outside leg stump, Abhishek sweeps that over the square leg boundary
pushes the first one through on a length on leg stump, no real sign of spin, Head pushes it in front of square on the legside
a shot of authority from Abhishek! Short ball into the body from Omarzai, Abhishek transfers the weight onto the backfoot and belts a superb pull shot behind square
length ball drifitng into the pads, Abhishek whips it behind square on the leg side and is off the mark with a couple of runs
length ball on middle and off stump, pushed to extra cover
gets the radar wrong on this one, it's too far down leg, Abhishek looks to pick it up over fine leg but doesn't get any bat on it. He'll get the extra run and the extra ball though
Bouncer first up, Abhishek ducks under it

The pressure has told on Mayank! Shorter length ball, 137ks, tucking up Mayank, who goes for the swivel pull but the line had tucked him up so he couldn't get a free swing going, Nalkande pockets a simple catch at deep square leg
fuller length ball on leg stump, Mayank misses the flick and gets hit on the front pad. Stifled appeal from Omarzai which is denied
short ball on middle and leg, Mayank tucks it behind square but doesn't get enough timing on it, so it's just dribbled through to the left of short fine as they get a single

short ball outside off stump, Mayank gives himself room and misses the upper cut, it's called a wide much to Umesh's surprise. He's persuaded Gill to go for the review as well, and it's just as well he did that. It's a fair delivery
slower ball, just back of a length, on middle and off stump, Head hacks it down to long-on
length ball on off stump, Mayank looks to pull, probably wasn't short enough to play that shot so it hits the pad and dribbles through to short third and they sprint across for a leg bye
length ball on off stump, seemed to come back in off the seam a touch, Mayank adjusts nicely in dabbing it towards short third, but there's no run there
Shot! Innocuous delivery, right in the slot for Mayank to hit through the line, he needs no second invitation as he clears the left foot and lofts this over mid-on
back of a length on middle stump, Mayank looks to flick, misses it and it lobs through to backward point off the front pad

Poor misfield from Mohit at mid-off. Length ball just outside off, Mayank pushes it wide of mid-off, but Mohit overruns to his left and lets it go through his right hand to give Mayank a release after some pressure might have been building
good length ball, tight line attacking the stumps, Mayank blocks it back to the bowler
length ball on middle and off stump, Mayank goes back and across and pushes it to midwicket
back of a length angling across from off stump, Head looks to flay it square on the offside but gets an inside edge through to short fine
length ball drifting into the pads, Mayank misses the flick and it dribbles through to short fine off the thigh pad and they run through for a leg bye to put Head back on strike
goes shorter this time, Head stays legside and looks to unfurl the ramp but misses it
length ball pitching on off and angling across Head, he looks to smash it through the line and down the ground again, hits the bottom of the bat and goes through on the bounce to mid-off
Take that, says Head! Length ball on off stump, no movement, Head gets the front foot out of the way and bludgeons it through the line and past Umesh for his third boundary

This time he doesn't miss out, another ball drifting into the pads from Umesh, Mayank is nicely balanced in flicking it past midwicket, Nalkande gives it a good chase and makes a diving stop to save a run
length ball on leg stump, flicked to midwicket, Mayank will be annoyed to have missed out on that one
back of a length ball, on middle and leg, sticks in the wicket a little as Mayank is too early into the flick and lobs it over Nalkande at fielder
length ball on off stump, Head stays leg side of it and drives to mid-off
Omarzai goes around the wicket and angles it too far down leg, Head doesn't get a proper connection on the flick this time, but gets it wide enough of fine leg for them to go through for a couple
Omarzai overcorrects, this is a leg-stump half volley, Head clips it away in the air past square leg and he's off like a train again
short and wide, a nice gift to welcome Head back to Ahmedabad! Rocks back and punches it through the gap between cover point and extra cover
similar line and length again, some away shape again, Mayank gives himself a touch of room and drives wide of mid-off, where Gill moves to his left and makes a diving stop to keep it down to one
full ball, a hint of shape away after pitching on off stump, Mayank punches confidently off the front foot but can only find mid-off
Yeah, wide and in the slot. It's launched over long-off. Miller carries Titans home.

Scores tied with a pull to the left of deep fine leg. Miller was hobbling but the throw was wide to the keeper's end. Was a shortish pacy ball at the body that had Vijay tuck his belly back while pulling
Wide and slow. Miller shapes to cut, may have considered letting it go as it might've been wide but then held back on going through with the cut. Gets it to deep point
Low full toss on off, pushed back to the bowler. 146ks
Yorker on off, driven off the bottom of the bat to long-on. Looked pace-on
Slow bumper, pulled from outside off to deep midwicket
Bumper. Pacy and at the stumps, pulled to deep square leg
Slow, wide and full. Slapped off the bottom of the bat, to long-off
Dipping yorker on off, Shankar was close to playing it too early but managed to delay jamming the bat and turning it to midwicket
Slower bouncer at the helmet. Looked to have beaten the pull, deflected to short third. No concussion check needed
Pushes the fullish ball outside off to cover
Game's firmly in GT's bag now. Cutter, slightly on a back of length, on off, Vijay backed away upon impact and slapped it through extra cover
Top edges a pull behind the keeper, Klaasen chases valiantly but can't pull it in despite the dive. Was a slower bouncer around shoulder-height that was pulled from in front of the body
Slapped, misfield at cover costs four. Asking rate now under six. Wide and shortish, it went on the bounce to the right of the fielder. Went right through him
Wide on a three-quarter length, slapped to cover
This is Miller's playground, he knows the angles perfectly. Got a length ball that didn't bounce much but he got his hands low and rolled the wrist on the pull into the ground, four to long leg
Pacy again. Bumper on middle and leg, tries to hook it but gets it off the sticker to deep fine leg
Low fully. Pace-on, from over the wicket. Pushed from off stump to cover
Pulled, holes out to deep midwicket. Was a length ball that was hit from deep in the crease, Sudharsan tried to clear Abhishek but a sliding catch was taken in the end

24 runs off the over and that is likely to be decisive. Not violent but it travels far. Looped up on the fuller side of length outside off, Miller takes a small stride across, reaches out with his upper body and free-swings it with a rotational arc
Wide on a fullish length, reaches out and has a one-handed swipe to point
GT have marked their target and these two turning it in their favour in this over. Sudharsan dances down and thumps it over wide long-on with a free swing
Wide again, tries to slap it but goes off the underedge behind the keeper
Wide again, outside off and goes past the bat swing
He is breaking free. Dances down and creams it over extra cover. Was a wide length ball, he reached out
Miller finally connects, clubs it between long-on and deep midwicket. Was a length ball tossed up outside off. Miller hasn't been running freely, so he might be looking to break free
Wide on a length, goes too far away and is let go
Bhuvi has Miller reaching out to end the over quietly. Length ball, he had to reach out and try to carve it. Plinked it to the left of short third
Tries to muscle it through cover, cloths it into the grass instead. Was a length ball angling away through fifth
Clips the length ball to deep midwicket
Bumper goes too high. 129ks, fifth-stump line, Sudharsan wound down and then leapt to try and go for another upper cut but it kept sponging up
Length on middle and off, punched towards mid-off and Miller takes off for the run
Upper cuts it fine. Ball rolls to deep third. 127ks and short, angling towards fifth, Sudharsan stood upright and helped it along, didn't get all the pace he was looking for
Shortish outside off, 127ks, pulled to deep midwicket
Length outside off, chopped to deep forward point
Length outside off, clipped to midwicket. Bowler chases it
Chops it from outside off to deep cover

Quick two, full-length dive and slide. Miller takes two when it wasn't on. Was a length ball outside off that was cut to deep point's right. Shahbaz ran across and threw it like in regulation, maybe should've yanked it harder
Length middle, worked legside
Uses the angle and the bounce, the shortish length ball rose just above pad height and was delicately pulled fine and in the gap
Length at the stumps, clipped to midwicket. Titans take the timeout early
Sudharsan is ready for the pace-on Test-like ball. It's length over fourth, 139ks, he waits and guides it with an open face, wide of the diving short-third fielder
Get the slower bouncer wrong for a change. This bounces too high. Line was outside off, Sudharsan jumped up to try and slap it high. Didn't have to in the end.
Back to pace off to get another underedge. Offcutter on a shortish length, spun away, Sudharsan tried to carve it square
Pace on this time. 142ks, length around fifth, guided to deep third.
Real short slower one. Tennis-ball bounce over fifth-stump, Miller is caught between shots. Ended up trying to knock it to the offside but underedged it to the grass behind
Slow and shortish, angling in towards fourth, pulled to midwicket
Fullish and slow, worked to the legside
Similar shot to the first ball but this time he went straighter and higher. The length was fullish but line was around middle and off, pace on too, so he could pump it through the line with ease
Slower one has Miller defending closer to the body than he probably would've otherwise. 110ks, on a length, angling in towards off. He shaped to slap it but ended up bunting it towards point
Length outside off, slapped to cover point
Slower bouncer, 114ks, seemed like it turned in. Pulled from fourth stump to deep square leg
Driven on the up, to mid-off. Three-quarter length, fifth-stump line, hit just below the sticker of the bat
Length on middle, clipped to midwicket, 138ks
Into the pitch, 113ks, outside off, whipped with a cross-bat towards long-on
Length just outside off, guided to deep third
Pace-on. Fullish on off, worked to long-on
Length on the hips, helped to deep fine leg
Starts with a cutter into a length. Slapped from outside off, to extra
Wide and full, driven to depp cover
Tries to run it to third, misses. Slider is wide on a length, Sudharsan reached out with his upper body, had too far to reach
Sits up for the cut, spun away too, so it must have been the googly. 83ks, hit to deep point
Full on leg, swept to deep-backward square
Fullish on off, worked to long-on

Gill holes out to long-on. Mistake in execution cos the ball was in his slot. Slow on leg, 89ks, he danced down and probably got too close to the pitch. Maybe he wanted to go wider. Markande and SRH will take that with both hands
Length on fifth, steered to the left of deep point. Timeout called
Length on middle, clipped to the square-leg outfield. Fielder doesn't have to run that much but the batters scamper through anyway
Paddle/semi-pulled wide of short fine leg. It was length and just down leg, knee-roll height. Gill crouched and shovelled it around the corner with a short backlift and follow-through
Good short-arm pull across the line. Picked the length ball from middle and off and directed it in the gap at square leg
Length around fifth, 103ks, clipped to midwicket
Darted on the shorter side, fifth stump line, pulled hard but connection ain't perfect. Straight to deep midwicket
Dances down and punches the length ball to the bowler, who stops it in follow-through
Wide and fullish, Sudharsan opens up and has to reach out to slice it to backward point's left.
Given air. Fullish on middle, clipped gently to forward square leg
Fullish on the pads, nudged to square leg
Full on middle and off, nudged to long-on
Full on off, stays legside of the ball and drives to the right of deep cover
Fullish dart on leg, flicked to backward square leg
Fullish on leg, clipped to the diagonal-right of deep square leg. They push for two, fielder can't pick it up cleanly
Square drives the length ball outside off, to the offside sweeper
Tight run to cover, throw is off. Ball was on a tad back of length and wide-ish, it spun back towards fifth. Gill cut it to cover, who ran in but wrung the ball into the ground
Length on off, punched to the left of catching midwicket
Length on off, punched to cover
Length at the stumps, clipped to wide mid-off
Length on middle and off, 129ks, clipped to deep square leg
Not that bad a ball but he whips it through wicket nonchalantly. Length on middle and off in fact, Sudharsan didn't have to transfer weight and timed it perfectly
Shortish and slow, 122ks, Sudharsan charged and tried to pull it. Not middled, goes to midwicket
Length on off, punched off the back foot to cover
Length around off, 135ks, punched to mid-on
Fullish on off, clipped to deep midwicket. 95ks
Full and at the body, worked to midwicket
Dances down and flays it over extra. It was wide, 96ks, on a length. Didn't matter to him as he had a rotational swipe
Full on middle, pushed to mid-on
Length on leg, clipped to deep midwicket

Change of ends works for Shahbaz. He went fuller side of length, 89ks, at the stumps. Saha lunged forward but had to reach too far forward as he tried to lift it over midwicket. Having to do it on the up didn't help. Ends up spooning it.
Fullish on middle and leg, 112ks, whisked to midwicket
Full toss has been whipped over forward square leg. Free hit essentially. Knee-roll high, middle-stump line, Saha picked it up without having to move
Fullish on fourth, pushed to long-off
Slower one negates Saha's dance down the pitch. The into-the-pitch ball goes under the bat as he tried to pull. Actually took an underedge onto body before dribbling to the offside
Slow on the fuller side of length, fourth stump, defended towards cover
Pitched up, angling away through fifth, driven to the left of long-off
Clips the length ball on the pads to deep fine leg

Dances down and lofts it over wide mid-off. Slower one, 119ks, picks up the length ball and forces it despite not getting all that close to the pitch. Bat-face turned but the power was enough to get it into the outfield
Fullish on fifth, guided with an angled bat, to the right of backward point
Fullish on the pads, clipped to midwicket
Check-bunt, pops up but goes to midwicket on the bounce. Back of length, 136ks, just outside off, Gill shaped to pull but pulled back due to the bit of spongy extra bounce
Length in the channel, pulled off the bottom-half of the bat, to the side of the diving midwicket fielder
Full outside off, driven to long-off
Length on middle, worked to midwicket

Uppish but wide to the right of the bowler. Went over head too, so it was too far of the leaping bowler. Length just outside off, Saha tried cuffing it with a flat bat, the face seemed to turn on impact
Walking whip over cow corner. Overpitched on the pads, 91ks, Saha took a step forward, lifted the back leg up and flicked it seamlessly
Length outside off, punched to long-off
Full on the pads, given air, clipped to midwicket
Fullish on leg, tries to work it across to the leg side. Goes off the outer-half of the bat, into the pitch and back to the bowler

Bhuvi pulls his length back and Gill short-arm slaps it through cover. He walked into the stroke, had a bit of width and crunched it with the cross-bat. Follow-through stopped halfway as he held the pose
Length around sixth, goes back and pushes it to cover. Not much swing
Stirred to backward point. Length on fifth, defended slightly away from the body
Fullish in the channel, induces the thick outside edge. But Gill played it with low hands, so it went along the ground and to the left of deep-backward point
Guided past backward point, stopped at deep third. Was a length ball in the channel
